==Description==
'''M-60i''' is one of the many I variants within [[Section M]], it is the I variant of [[M-60]], more info below.

==Behavior==
When '''M-60i''' spawns, [[Oblivion]] will mark and highlight all lockers '''M-60i''' does not intend to check with a red "✓'. Then, '''M-60i''' will rush to the main room, checking rooms with players and ones surrounding them. Once '''M-60i''' has checked all unmarked lockers, he will accelerate to the main room then fallback to the '''Void Wall''', where he will despawn, acting very similarly to [[A-135i]] but only rebounding once.

==Strategy & Tips==
* If you hear the sound of multiple lockers being marked when opening a door, you should know that its '''M-60i''' coming. So quickly go to a marked locker and hide in it.
* Don't be an idiot. If '''M-60i''' spawns, just hide in the marked locker. Don't try to outrun '''M-60i''' by rushing forward, this will only cause '''M-60i''' to check even more lockers and kill you. If you're in a hurry, at least use a safe spot so you can instantly return to rush once '''M-60i''' finish checking the lockers.
* '''M-60i''' used to not kill the player in unmarked lockers, however, that was recently patched. 

== Trivia ==
* '''M-60i''' has 1 in 30 chance to replace [[M-60]] when [[M-60]] attempts to spawn.
* '''M-60i'''<nowiki/>'s name is "<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 4px red; color:black;">Mediator</span>".
* Lockers won't be marked by [[Oblivion]] during any Perfection Event, due to [[Overseer]] taking their place for the events.
